newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Feb industrial output seen down - employers.
newsitem.headline: Italy Feb industrial output seen down - employers.

text.p: Italian industrial production is seen falling 1.1 percent year-on-year in February and by a seasonally-adjusted 1.2 percent from January, the employers' body Confindustria said in its latest economic report.
Latest official figures showed industrial production fell 3.1 percent in December year-on-year.
Confindustria said that while its three-month moving average showed a slight increase, output was still basically stationary around the low levels seen in spring and summer of 1996.
Sales showed a 2.2 percent fall in February year-on-year due to a 2.9 percent drop on foreign markets and a 1.6 percent decline on the domestic market, the report said.
But new orders showed a slight rise of 0.7 percent year-on-year, particularly in the auto, clothing, non-ferrous metals and chemicals/pharmaceutical sectors.
